note: Studio Concepts are invented, self-initiated examples of Membership work. Not client work. Covers use optional media: multi-item media[] is manual-only (arrows/dots), while a single src/poster is one still or muted looping video; empty media keeps flat grey. An .svg src (cover media or frame) is concept art: canvas.js inlines it so it uses the site fonts; the files are written by scripts/build-concept-art.py. Legacy poster/src fields still work as single-frame fallbacks. date is the honest When for every concept ("Studio concept · 2026"; meta rows show only the year). There is no location: concepts have no client site, so no Where (JC, 2026-10-02). layoutMotif drives a distinct fullscreen folio layout per deliverable type. coverW/coverH vary the floor silhouette (24px grid multiples). layout.grid (24) is the floor unit; cover x/y/coverW/coverH and world size are multiples of it. Cover x/y/coverW/coverH/expand and world come from scripts/layout-masonry.py (equal-width masonry). layout.start is the concept centred at 100% when the floor first loads. layout.caption is the caption strip under each cover on the floor (world px; coverH is the art alone). hidden: true keeps a concept in the file but off every page (floor, Grid, List, Index, Membership list); layout-masonry.py and sync-index.py skip it too. moves: the three studio moves (Designed / Taught / Stayed on) shown on the item page. Portfolio items show deliverables only: no cadence, chunks, plan tier or pricing (JC, 2026-10-04).
